full_name: Activity Inventory (AI) driving goal and 21 driving tasks
domains: driving tasks (goal importance and difficulty plus 21 tasks)
response_scale: importance 0-3 (not to extremely important); difficulty 0-4 (not difficult to impossible); tasks same scale or not applicable
scoring: Rasch rating scale model (Andrich; WINSTEPS 3.16) person measure in logits
notes: AI used here had 50 goal-level items (p2); driving goal plus 21 tasks analysed; person separation reliability 0.87, item separation reliability 0.98 (p4); telephone interview
